## Dashboard Page Structure Exploration Report

I've successfully explored the Next.js app router structure and identified all the key components. Here's what I found:

### 1. All Pages Under `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/` Directory

The dashboard has the following page structure organized into 8 main sections:

**Top-level Dashboard Page:**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/page.tsx` - Main dashboard with running/warning index cards

**Analysis Pages (3 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/analysis/dictionary/page.tsx` - Dictionary management with multiple tabs (stop words, synonyms, etc.)
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/analysis/tools/page.tsx` - Document analyzer tools
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/analysis/detail-analyzer/page.tsx` - Detail analyzer

**Indices Pages (3 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/indices/page.tsx` - Index list view
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/indices/templates/page.tsx` - Index templates
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/indices/[indexName]/page.tsx` - Individual index details

**Collections Pages (2 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/collections/page.tsx` - Collections list
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/collections/[collectionId]/page.tsx` - Individual collection details

**Search Pages (2 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/search/query-test/page.tsx` - Query testing (Kibana integration)
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/search/reference-ui/page.tsx` - Reference UI

**Management Pages (3 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/management/jdbc/page.tsx` - JDBC configuration
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/management/pipeline/page.tsx` - Pipeline management
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/management/scheduler/page.tsx` - Scheduler configuration

**Cluster Pages (3 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/cluster/page.tsx` - Cluster overview
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/cluster/nodes/page.tsx` - Node information
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/cluster/settings/page.tsx` - Cluster settings

**Users Pages (2 sub-pages):**
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/users/page.tsx` - Users management
- `/src/app/(dashboard)/[clusterId]/users/roles/page.tsx` - Role management

---

### 2. Sidebar/Navigation Component

**File:** `/Users/admin/project/admin/search-admin-ui/src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx`

**Key Features:**
- Uses `useParams()` and `usePathname()` from Next.js navigation
- Uses `useUIStore()` for sidebar visibility state
- Each menu item has a `title`, `icon`, `href` function, and `match` function for active state detection
- Renders as a 64px wide sidebar with horizontal navigation links
- Conditionally renders only when `sidebarOpen` is true and `clusterId` exists

### 3. How Routes Are Currently Organized

**Layout Hierarchy:**
```
src/app/
├── layout.tsx (Root layout - no providers visible)
├── page.tsx (Home/cluster selector)
├── (auth)/ (Auth group)
│   ├── layout.tsx
│   ├── login/page.tsx
│   ├── callback/page.tsx
└── (dashboard)/ (Dashboard group)
    ├── layout.tsx (Imports Sidebar + Header)
    └── [clusterId]/
        ├── page.tsx (Dashboard home)
        ├── analysis/
        │   ├── dictionary/page.tsx
        │   ├── tools/page.tsx
        │   └── detail-analyzer/page.tsx
        ├── indices/
        │   ├── page.tsx
        │   ├── templates/page.tsx
        │   └── [indexName]/page.tsx
        ├── collections/
        │   ├── page.tsx
        │   └── [collectionId]/page.tsx
        ├── search/
        │   ├── query-test/page.tsx
        │   └── reference-ui/page.tsx
        ├── management/
        │   ├── jdbc/page.tsx
        │   ├── pipeline/page.tsx
        │   └── scheduler/page.tsx
        ├── cluster/
        │   ├── page.tsx
        │   ├── nodes/page.tsx
        │   └── settings/page.tsx
        └── users/
            ├── page.tsx
            └── roles/page.tsx
```

**Key Organization Patterns:**

1. **Route Groups:** Uses `(dashboard)` and `(auth)` route groups to organize layouts
2. **Dynamic Segments:** Uses `[clusterId]` and `[collectionId]` for dynamic routing
3. **Layout Inheritance:** All pages under `(dashboard)` inherit the dashboard layout with sidebar
4. **Sidebar in Layout:** `/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx` imports and renders the `Sidebar` component
5. **No nested layouts:** No additional layout files exist under `[clusterId]` - all pages use the same dashboard layout
6. **Default routes:** When clicking "Analysis", it defaults to `/[clusterId]/analysis/dictionary`

### Implementation Plan for Hiding All Pages Except `/analysis`

To hide all pages except `/analysis`, you would need to:

1. **Modify `/src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx`:**
   - Filter the `menuItems` array to only include the "Analysis" item
   - Remove the other 7 menu items from the array

2. **Or, conditionally render items:**
   - Modify the map function to skip rendering non-analysis items
   - Update the item filtering logic based on a configuration or environment variable

3. **Optional - Redirect on page access:**
   - Add middleware or route protection to redirect to `/analysis` when users try to access other routes
   - Modify the root dashboard page to redirect to `/analysis`

4. **Optional - Remove pages from disk:**
   - Delete the page files for unwanted routes (indices, collections, search, management, cluster, users)
   - This prevents accidental access but doesn't prevent direct navigation
